project_type: Multi-system emulator. Rust core engine (crates/emulator-bridge) compiled to WASM for a web PWA and to native ARM64 for iOS via a UniFFI Swift facade. The iOS shell (native/ios/) is built only on GitHub Actions macos-latest. This task is a Swift-only architectural change on the ps1-pcsx-rearmed branch: it replaces security-scoped folder streaming with an Import-and-Copy Library backed by the app's own Documents directory.
language: Swift (iOS shell). Rust, YAML and the build scripts are untouched this task.
build_system: iOS: XcodeGen (native/ios/project.yml) -> xcodebuild, orchestrated by native/ios/build-engine.sh then native/ios/package-ipa.sh; both refuse to run on non-Darwin. Rust: Cargo workspace pinned to Rust 1.92.0. project.yml lists target sources EXPLICITLY (ContinuumApp.swift, MetalCanvas.swift, build/Generated), so any new .swift file would also have to be added there; keeping everything in ContinuumApp.swift avoids that build-file mismatch entirely.
test_framework: cargo test (74 unit tests) proves the Rust side did not regress. For the Swift change the only in-sandbox gate is swiftc -frontend -parse, which is a spell-checker: it cannot see UIKit/SwiftUI/Foundation types, so correctness rests on careful by-eye review plus the orchestrator's macOS CI build.
build_command: cargo test (Rust regression proof). The real iOS type-check and .ipa build run only on the macOS CI runner.
verification_instructions: In this Linux sandbox: (1) swiftc -frontend -parse native/ios/ContinuumApp.swift -> exit 0, and then read by eye: UIDocumentPickerViewController(forOpeningContentTypes:asCopy:), allowsMultipleSelection, all four @objc selectors (didPickDocumentsAt, didPickDocumentAt, documentPickerWasCancelled, presentationControllerDidDismiss), present(_:animated:completion:), FileManager copyItem/removeItem/contentsOfDirectory/urls(for:in:), List + ForEach identity through a stable Identifiable model (never array indices), and every Task { @MainActor } hop. (2) grep for activeScopedURL, failAfterScope, selectLaunchEntry, LaunchEntryOutcome, UTType.folder -> zero hits; grep engine.launch -> exactly one call site. (3) cargo test -> 74 passing. (4) If project.yml or Info.plist are touched, re-validate with python3 yaml.safe_load and python3 plistlib; remember XcodeGen OVERWRITES Info.plist from targets.Continuum.info.properties, so a new plist key MUST be declared in project.yml or it is dropped from the built app. The macOS build and on-device import/launch CANNOT run here and are verified only by the orchestrator's CI and device run.
snapshot_or_generated_files: The .xcodeproj is generated by xcodegen from native/ios/project.yml (gitignored). UniFFI bindings are generated by build-engine.sh into native/ios/build/Generated/ (gitignored). XcodeGen also regenerates native/ios/Info.plist from auto-default keys merged with targets.Continuum.info.properties and overwrites the committed file, so the committed plist is only a human-readable seed.
setup_instructions: swiftc (Linux Swift, Foundation only, no iOS SDK), python3 and rustup 1.92.0 with the aarch64-apple-ios and wasm32-unknown-unknown targets are already installed. No macOS, no Xcode, no xcodegen, no iOS SDK.
environment_constraints: No macOS/Xcode/iOS SDK/xcodegen in the sandbox, and no device. swiftc -frontend -parse accepts type errors in UIKit/SwiftUI code, so it proves syntax only. The on-screen HUD is the only debugger on a sideloaded build, which is why every failure path must write a distinct status string rather than aborting silently.
contribution_requirements: Work on branch ps1-pcsx-rearmed; commit locally only. Do NOT push, open or modify a PR, or trigger CI (the orchestrator publishes). Change ONLY native/ios/ContinuumApp.swift, plus native/ios/project.yml and native/ios/Info.plist if genuinely needed. Do NOT modify crates/**, scripts/**, or .github/workflows/**. Do NOT change the Rust launch/need_fullpath path: it already accepts an absolute file path. Keep the 74 cargo tests passing. No em dashes anywhere in code comments or strings.
key_patterns: GROUND TRUTH read from native/ios/ContinuumApp.swift before planning. WHAT MUST GO: EngineHost.allowedTypes = [UTType.folder]; presentFolderPicker(); launch(url:) treating the URL as a folder, calling url.startAccessingSecurityScopedResource() and storing it in activeScopedURL; failAfterScope(_:_:) which released that scope; selectLaunchEntry(in:) plus the LaunchEntryOutcome enum and launchExtensionPriority folder enumeration; the scope release inside stopSession(); PS1.romExtensions (already dead). WHAT MUST STAY: the strongly retained picker delegate property on EngineHost (UIDocumentPickerViewController.delegate is WEAK, and a locally created delegate is deallocated before the callback fires, which was a real bug); activePicker retention and releaseActivePicker(); both @objc pick callbacks (array form and deprecated single-URL form) forwarding into one path; @objc documentPickerWasCancelled; presentationControllerDidDismiss with the outcomeDelivered suppression so it cannot overwrite a real result; prepareForNewPicker(); present(picker, animated: true) { ... } with the 'picker is up' line written INSIDE the completion because present is async and a synchronous claim was a real bug; topmostViewController() and the 'cannot present picker: no root view controller' path; @MainActor isolation on EngineHost with explicit Task { @MainActor in ... } hops that bind `let host = self.host` first so only Sendable values cross; PickerOutcome as the Sendable carrier; ensureCoreLoaded() declaring and loading the core on surface attach without launching content; the BIOS/HLE HUD line; MetalCanvasView/MetalCanvas and the lifecycle Coordinator; .preferredColorScheme(.dark); and a single engine.launch call site. WHY THE ARCHITECTURE CHANGES: on device the folder pick returns cancelled or never delivers, and security-scoped streaming from outside the sandbox is too fragile, so files are copied into Documents where no scope exists to be denied. WHY THE PICKER STAYS PERMISSIVE: iOS has no built-in UTType for .cue/.bin/.chd/.pbp, so UTType(filenameExtension:) returns nil for them and the picker GREYS THOSE FILES OUT; that bug already cost two iterations, so the picker offers [UTType.item] (every file conforms) and acceptance is enforced after the pick by extension. WHY FILENAMES ARE PRESERVED: a .cue names its tracks literally, for example FILE "Crash Bandicoot (Track 1).bin" BINARY, so a rename-to-avoid-collision silently breaks the game; collisions overwrite, never rename, and every file in a batch lands in the SAME directory so cue to bin references resolve. FREE FALLBACK: UIFileSharingEnabled and LSSupportsOpeningDocumentsInPlace are ALREADY set in both project.yml info.properties and the seed Info.plist, so files dragged into the app's Documents folder through Finder or the Files app show up in the Library scan with no extra code.
relevant_files: native/ios/ContinuumApp.swift [MODIFY: the whole import/launch architecture. Picker for files with allowsMultipleSelection = true and asCopy: true over [UTType.item]; post-pick extension filter (cue, bin, chd, pbp, iso) with a distinct HUD line naming any rejected file and its extension; per-file copy into Documents preserving the filename exactly, overwrite on collision, independent do/catch, per-file and summary HUD lines; a LibraryEntry Identifiable model keyed on absolute path; refreshLibrary() scanning Documents and filtering to cue/chd/pbp/iso; a SwiftUI LibraryView with an Import Games button, empty-state guidance, size and extension detail, and swipe to delete; launch(entry:) passing entry.path to the single engine.launch call site with rom: Data(); removal of activeScopedURL, failAfterScope, selectLaunchEntry, LaunchEntryOutcome and UTType.folder; stopSession() reduced to stopping the engine]

native/ios/project.yml [NO CHANGE NEEDED: UIFileSharingEnabled and LSSupportsOpeningDocumentsInPlace are already in targets.Continuum.info.properties, and no new plist key is required. Re-validate as YAML only.]
native/ios/Info.plist [NO CHANGE NEEDED: the seed already carries both keys. Re-validate with plistlib only.]
directory_structure: native/ios/ holds ContinuumApp.swift (the SwiftUI host plus EngineHost), MetalCanvas.swift, project.yml (XcodeGen spec, explicit source list), Info.plist (seed, overwritten by xcodegen), Continuum.entitlements, and the macOS-only build-engine.sh + package-ipa.sh. crates/emulator-bridge/ holds the Rust engine (uniffi_api.rs launch path, cores/native_core.rs loader), untouched this task. .agents/tasks/ holds task state. SESSION_HANDOFF.md is the canonical handoff doc and is outside this task's allowed file scope.
